name: Kinetic typography
summary: Big bold words that punch in on the beat, then stack into one line.

text.label: Your words
text.hint: Short and punchy works best: 2 to 6 words.

name: Particle field
summary: Thousands of glowing dots drifting along soft currents, like smoke or wind.

text.label: Your text
text.hint: A headline or a short line, shown in the lower third.

name: 3D logo spin
summary: A shiny 3D logo that spins, settles and floats, ready for an intro or outro.

text.label: Brand name
text.hint: Shown under the logo. Its first letter goes on the badge.
